Source: https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html

# Set up the Vydrop browser extension

Use the optional companion to send the video you are watching to the desktop app, then review it before downloading. Setup is free. You can also paste a link directly into the app.

**Use the matching package:** [Vydrop 4.4.6 for Windows](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) includes companion **Vydrop 1.5.4**. Open **Vydrop.exe** and use its included **Browser** folder. When upgrading from ViFree, enable the connection from Vydrop and reload the companion from the new folder.

**Reddit and LinkedIn:** companion 1.5.4 uses the selected Reddit main video's public playlist, including audio. On newer LinkedIn feed cards it reads that card's own post menu and matches its public embed media to the selected video image. Protected or unavailable streams still cannot be downloaded.

[Published downloads](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/latest) · [Chrome](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#chrome) · [Edge](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#edge) · [Firefox](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#firefox) · [Troubleshooting](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#troubleshooting) · [العربية](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#arabic)

**Installer users:** [Vydrop 4.4.6 Setup](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/VydropSetup-v4.4.6-win-x64.exe) registers the app connection automatically. The browser stores are not published yet. Open **Browser integration → choose your browser → Set up**, finish the browser loading step, then use **Test connection**. The portable instructions below also remain available.
## Watch the setup video

    Your browser can download the MP4 using the link below.

English narration with English and Arabic captions. The video shows the 4.2.5 portable setup window and labeled browser illustrations; the 4.4.6 installer registers the app connection automatically. Choose full screen to see the controls clearly.

[Download the setup video (MP4)](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/media/vydrop-extension-setup.mp4) · [English captions](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/media/vydrop-extension-setup.en.vtt) · [الترجمة العربية](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/media/vydrop-extension-setup.ar.vtt)

The video covers extraction, the app connection, the correct Chrome/Edge folder, Firefox's temporary installation and sending your first public video. The written steps below cover the same setup.

## Quick setup

1. **Extract the full ZIP** into a permanent folder and open **Vydrop.exe**. Keep **Browser** beside the app.
2. Open **Settings → Browser integration**. In earlier builds, choose **Enable connection** (or **Reconnect app**). A connected status refers to this desktop app; you still load the extension in your browser.
3. **Load the extension** using the matching row below. In Vydrop 4.4.0 and later, choose your browser and **Set up Chrome**, **Set up Edge** or **Set up Firefox**. This connects the app, copies the correct path and opens the browser page. Manual actions remain under **Connection help**. Earlier versions use **Enable connection**, then the same addresses and files below; copy the path from File Explorer.
4. **Close setup, refresh your video page and play the video.** Click the Vydrop button, review the video in the app, then choose Download.

| Browser | Address to enter in that browser | Loading action | What to select |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Chrome](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#chrome) | `chrome://extensions` | Developer mode → Load unpacked | The **Browser\chromium** folder |
| [Edge](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#edge) | `edge://extensions` | Developer mode → Load unpacked | The same **Browser\chromium** folder |
| [Firefox](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html#firefox) | `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` | This Firefox → Load Temporary Add-on… | The **Browser\firefox\manifest.json** file |

Paste the copied path into the browser's file-picker address bar and press **Enter**. Chrome/Edge need a **folder**; Firefox needs a **file**. Browser confirmation is required. Firefox's local installation is temporary and must be loaded again after a restart.

If **Open extensions page** cannot find your browser, use **Copy browser address** and paste it into that browser's address bar. If the path buttons are disabled, extract the **complete** app ZIP again; copying Vydrop.exe alone leaves out the extension.

## Detailed illustrated instructions

The native app setup, Chrome and video-to-app steps below use **real screenshots**, preserved as original PNG files. Highlighted frames focus on the controls to use. Choose **Zoom to original size** below a screenshot to read its controls without shrinking them; scroll inside the enlarged view, or click the image to open the original. Edge and Firefox use labelled illustrations. Control positions can vary by browser version.

## 1. Extract and keep the app folder

The Chrome screenshots show companion 1.3.5. The included 1.5.4 companion uses the same setup controls; confirm the new version after loading or reloading it.

Extract the app ZIP into a permanent writable folder, such as **Documents\Vydrop**. Open **Vydrop.exe** from that folder and keep **Browser** beside it. Keep the extracted files after setup.

![Extracted Vydrop folder containing Browser and Vydrop.exe](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/01-extracted-app.png)

Keep Browser beside Vydrop.exe in the extracted app folder. The drive and folder name shown are examples.

## 2. Connect the app and choose your browser

In Vydrop 4.4.6, open **Settings → Browser integration**, choose your browser, then choose **Set up Chrome**, **Set up Edge** or **Set up Firefox**. The action registers this app, copies the matching extension path and opens the browser's setup page. Paste the copied path when the browser asks you to select the extension. Keep setup open until you finish loading it, then refresh your video page.

![Native Vydrop setup window with browser selection, Set up Chrome and connection status](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/guided-setup-en.png)

Earlier app versions use **Enable connection** or **Reconnect app**, followed by the manual browser-loading steps below. In the current Browser integration page, those separate actions remain under **Connection help**.

## Chrome

### Open the extensions page

Enter `chrome://extensions` in Chrome's address bar. Alternatively, open Chrome's three-dot menu and choose **Extensions → Manage extensions**.

![Chrome Extensions submenu with Manage extensions](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/02-chrome-extensions-menu.png)

Open Chrome’s menu, then Extensions → Manage extensions. You can also enter chrome://extensions directly.

### Turn on Developer mode and choose Load unpacked

Switch **Developer mode** on in the extensions page, then click **Load unpacked**. The screenshot focuses on the loading button; the Developer mode switch is not included in this crop.

![Chrome extensions page with Load unpacked available](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/03-load-unpacked.png)

Turn Developer mode on first, then choose Load unpacked. The Developer mode switch is outside this screenshot.

### Find the correct extension folder

In the extracted Vydrop folder, open **Browser → chromium**. Click File Explorer's address bar and copy its full path. It must end in **Browser\chromium**, and that folder must contain **manifest.json**.

![Browser chromium folder path and its manifest.json file](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/04-chromium-folder-path.png)

Copy the full path ending in Browser\chromium. The folder contains manifest.json; Chrome needs this folder, not the ZIP.

Your app may be in Documents, Downloads or another drive. Use your own extracted folder's path; the **D:** drive in these screenshots is an example.

### Select Browser\chromium in Chrome

In Chrome's **Select the extension directory** dialog, paste the full path from the previous step into the address bar and press **Enter**. Confirm that it ends in **Browser\chromium**, then click **Select Folder**.

The screenshot below shows the dialog before the path is completed. **Do not select the outer Vydrop folder shown in its address bar:** append **\Browser\chromium** or paste the full path copied above before choosing Select Folder. Do not select the ZIP or only the outer Browser folder.

![Chrome folder chooser with address bar and Select Folder button](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/05-select-extension-folder.png)

In this dialog, replace the outer app-folder path shown with the full Browser\chromium path, press Enter, then choose Select Folder.

### Check that Vydrop is enabled

Look for the **Vydrop 1.5.4** card and keep its switch on. In **Details → Site access**, allow your desired websites; **On all sites** enables detection across supported sites. Optionally pin the companion from Chrome's Extensions menu.

![Vydrop 1.3.5 extension card with its switch enabled](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/06-vydrop-extension-enabled.png)

The Vydrop card confirms installation. Keep the switch on; use Details to allow access to the websites you want.

These loading steps follow the [official Chrome instructions](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/get-started/tutorial/hello-world#load-unpacked). Refresh already-open video pages after installation.

## Edge

1. Enter `edge://extensions` in Microsoft Edge's address bar.
2. Turn on **Developer mode** in the extensions page.
3. Choose **Load unpacked** and select **Browser\chromium**. Edge uses the same folder as Chrome.
4. Enable the companion. Open its **Details** and allow the websites where you want detection to run.
5. Refresh the video page. Use Edge's Extensions menu to show the companion on the toolbar if desired.

![Edge setup illustration showing its Developer mode control, Load unpacked and the shared chromium folder](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/04-edge-setup.svg)

See Microsoft's [official Edge sideloading instructions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions/getting-started/extension-sideloading). Browser wording and control positions may differ.

## Firefox

1. Enter `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` in Firefox's address bar.
2. Select **This Firefox** if it is not already selected.
3. Choose **Load Temporary Add-on…** and open **Browser\firefox\manifest.json** from the extracted app folder.
4. Refresh the page and play the video.

![Firefox illustration showing This Firefox, Load Temporary Add-on and Browser/firefox/manifest.json, with the restart limitation](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/05-firefox-setup.svg)

**This is a temporary installation:** Firefox removes the locally loaded companion when it restarts. Load it again next session. A permanent normal Firefox installation requires a Mozilla-signed add-on; this ZIP is not a signed store package. See Mozilla's [temporary installation documentation](https://extensionworkshop.com/documentation/develop/temporary-installation-in-firefox/).

## Send the playing video

Refresh the video page and play the video. Click **Download by Vydrop** inside its top-right corner, or use the companion's toolbar popup.

![Vydrop browser menu with Video and Audio tabs, format choices, quality choices and Download](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/browser-quality-en.png)

The actual browser quality menu after choosing Download by Vydrop. Select a format and quality, then explicitly press Download. The media is a local demonstration fixture.

Choose **Video** or **Audio**, then the format and an available quality. Select **Download** to start the chosen output in your saved Vydrop folder. This explicit confirmation can open Vydrop even when it is closed; other queued jobs keep their existing state.

![Vydrop 4.4.1 Queue with sample paused and waiting jobs](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/vydrop-light-en-queue.png)

After confirming Download, Vydrop opens Queue for the active transfer. Completed files appear in Library. This native capture uses example jobs.

## Review or change your save folder

In Vydrop, open **Add download** to choose the default save folder and inspect a link yourself. Older desktop versions can open this review screen instead of starting automatically. Update the app and reload the companion for the new quality menu. Public-link detection does not guarantee that every video can be downloaded.

![The native Add download workspace with media details and output choices](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/vydrop-light-en-download.png)

Add download lets you inspect a link and choose output, subtitles and a save folder in the main window. Example media is shown.

## Troubleshooting

| What happens | What to try |
| --- | --- |
| The app does not open | Open it manually, then use Settings → Browser integration → Enable connection again. Keep its folder in place. |
| Setup says connected, but no extension is present | The status confirms the desktop connection only. Load the extension in the selected browser, then refresh your video page. |
| The setup cannot open my browser | Copy the browser address shown in setup and paste it into that browser's address bar. |
| The extension path buttons are disabled | Extract the complete Vydrop ZIP and keep Browser beside Vydrop.exe. Reopen setup from the extracted app. |
| No tab appears beside the video | Check the companion is enabled and allowed on that site, refresh the page and play the visible video. Try its toolbar popup outside native fullscreen or picture-in-picture. |
| Several videos are present, or the wrong link appears | Open the specific video's public page, or paste the site's Share → Copy link into the app. |
| The right video opens, but downloading fails | DRM, private/sign-in-only media, custom players and site restrictions can prevent downloading. Report the public link and app version in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/issues). |
| Firefox loses the companion after restarting | Expected for a temporary add-on; load Browser\firefox\manifest.json again. |
| The app opens Preview | Load the regular companion from the matching desktop package and enable the connection from that app. |
| The icon or name looks old after an update | Reload the companion, then refresh the video page. The current Vydrop icon is the red V alone. |

The companion locates visible players and sends a public link after your click. It does not import accounts or cookies. Read the [browser extension privacy policy](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-privacy.html) for the information used, local transfer and retention, and the [permissions and limitations](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/blob/main/browser/README.md). These local packages are not Chrome, Edge or Firefox store listings.

## تفعيل الإضافة بالعربية

الإضافة اختيارية ومجانية. شرح إعداد التطبيق وChrome وإرسال الفيديو أعلاه يستخدم لقطات حقيقية، بينما صور Edge وFirefox رسومات توضيحية. يتضمن إصدار **Vydrop 4.4.6** إضافة **Vydrop 1.5.4**. فكّ ضغط حزمة البرنامج وافتح **Vydrop.exe**. [افتح الشرح العربي الكامل بالصور](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/ar/browser-extension-setup.html).

1. **فك الضغط:** احتفظ بمجلد البرنامج في مكان دائم، وبمجلد **Browser** بجوار الملف التنفيذي.
2. **فعّل الاتصال:** اختر **الإعدادات ← الربط بالمتصفح ← تفعيل الاتصال** وانتظر رسالة التأكيد.
3. **Chrome:** افتح `chrome://extensions`، فعّل **Developer mode**، ثم اختر **Load unpacked** وحدد **Browser\chromium** الذي يحتوي على manifest.json. [صورة زر التحميل](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/screenshots/03-load-unpacked.png).
4. **Edge:** افتح `edge://extensions` وفعّل **Developer mode**، ثم اختر **Load unpacked** وحدد **Browser\chromium** نفسه. [صورة Edge](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/04-edge-setup.svg).
5. **Firefox:** افتح `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`، واختر **Load Temporary Add-on**، ثم ملف **Browser\firefox\manifest.json**. [صورة Firefox](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/extension/05-firefox-setup.svg). هذه إضافة مؤقتة وتحتاج إلى تحميلها مجددًا بعد إعادة تشغيل Firefox؛ الحزمة الحالية ليست إضافة موقعة للتثبيت الدائم.
6. **السماح للمواقع:** فعّل الإضافة واسمح لها بالعمل على المواقع المطلوبة، ثم حدّث صفحات الفيديو المفتوحة.
7. **اختر ثم نزّل:** اضغط **تنزيل بواسطة Vydrop** داخل الزاوية العلوية اليمنى للفيديو، أو افتح الإضافة من شريط المتصفح. اختر فيديو أو صوتًا والصيغة والجودة، ثم أكّد **تنزيل** لبدء الاختيار في مجلد الحفظ.

إذا نقلت مجلد البرنامج، فعّل الاتصال مجددًا. عند تحديث الإضافة، أعد تحميلها وحدّث صفحة الفيديو. تختلف إمكانية التنزيل حسب الموقع وإتاحة الفيديو؛ لا تستورد الإضافة حساباتك أو ملفات تعريف الارتباط.

Source: https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/de/

# Vydrop: Videos und Audio unter Windows herunterladen

[Vydrop für Windows herunterladen](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) · Windows 10/11 x64 · v4.4.6

Vydrop 4.4.6 von Ziad Hassanein ist ein kostenloser, quelloffener Downloader für öffentliche Videos und Audio. Die Windows-App verwendet yt-dlp und unterstützt unter anderem YouTube, TikTok, Facebook und Vimeo, sofern ein geeigneter öffentlicher Stream verfügbar ist.

## Die Windows-App starten

Laden Sie das offizielle ZIP-Archiv herunter, entpacken Sie es in einen beschreibbaren Ordner und starten Sie **Vydrop.exe**. Benötigt wird Windows 10 oder 11 mit x64-Prozessor. Die .NET-Laufzeit ist enthalten. Fehlende Medienwerkzeuge werden beim ersten Link automatisch heruntergeladen und geprüft.

Diese Anleitung richtet sich an deutschsprachige Nutzer, insbesondere in Deutschland. Die App selbst bietet Englisch und Arabisch. **Video** steht für Video, **Audio** für Ton, **Download** startet das Herunterladen und **Recent downloads** öffnet die zuletzt gespeicherten Dateien. Weltweit wird dasselbe offizielle Windows-Paket verwendet.

## Ein Video speichern oder nur den Ton herunterladen

1. Kopieren Sie den öffentlichen Link des konkreten Videos, nicht die Startseite des sozialen Netzwerks.
2. Fügen Sie ihn in Vydrop ein. Während der Prüfung zeigt die Download-Schaltfläche den aktuellen Zustand.
3. Wählen Sie **Video** oder **Audio**, ein passendes Format, eine verfügbare Qualität und den Zielordner.
4. Klicken Sie auf **Download**. Für mehrere Links gibt es **Queue**; bei Wiedergabelisten lassen sich einzelne Einträge auswählen.
5. Nach Abschluss können Sie den Ausgabeordner über die fertige Aktion, die Warteschlange oder **Recent downloads** öffnen.

## Formate und Quellqualität

| Aufgabe | Formate | Voraussetzung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bild und Ton speichern | MP4, MKV, WebM | Die ermittelten Streams müssen zum Container passen. |
| Nur Audio speichern | MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, FLAC | Die Qualität bleibt durch die Quelle begrenzt. |
| Untertitel speichern | SRT, VTT | Die gewünschte Untertitelsprache muss verfügbar sein. |

Eine höhere Bitrate erzeugt keine zusätzlichen Quelldetails. Bei unbekannten Audio-Eigenschaften kann nur **Automatic** angeboten werden. Unter **Subtitles** wählen Sie vorhandene Untertitel; die Auswahl erscheint in der Medienübersicht. Vydrop unterstützt keine verschlüsselten DRM-Inhalte und umgeht keine Anmeldung.

## Chrome, Edge und Firefox verbinden

Öffnen Sie in Vydrop **Browser integration → choose your browser → Set up**. Installieren Sie anschließend die mitgelieferte Erweiterung 1.5.4:

- **Chrome:** Öffnen Sie chrome://extensions, aktivieren Sie den Entwicklermodus und laden Sie den entpackten Ordner **Browser/chromium**.
- **Edge:** Öffnen Sie edge://extensions und laden Sie nach Aktivierung des Entwicklermodus denselben Ordner.
- **Firefox:** Öffnen Sie about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox und laden Sie **Browser/firefox/manifest.json** als temporäres Add-on. Nach einem Firefox-Neustart muss es erneut geladen werden.

Erlauben Sie den Zugriff auf die gewünschten Websites und laden Sie Video-Tabs neu. **Download by Vydrop** erscheint oben rechts im Video. Wählen Sie Video oder Audio, Format und Qualität und bestätigen Sie **Download**. Die Ausgabe startet im gespeicherten Ordner, auch wenn Vydrop geschlossen war. Ältere App-Versionen öffnen die Vorschau.

Die [bebilderte Browser-Anleitung](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html) und die [Hinweise zu unterstützten Websites](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html) sind auf Englisch. Laden Sie nur Medien herunter, für deren Speicherung Sie die nötigen Rechte haben.

## Häufige Fragen

### Gibt es Vydrop auf Deutsch?

Diese Anleitung ist auf Deutsch. Die Desktop-App bietet derzeit eine englische und eine arabische Oberfläche. Sie läuft auf Windows 10 und 11 x64. Die Namen der englischen Schaltflächen werden hier erklärt.

### Kann Vydrop Videos von jeder Website herunterladen?

Vydrop nutzt yt-dlp für öffentliche Inhalte von mehr als 1.000 unterstützten Websites. Änderungen am Anbieter, der Player und Zugriffsbeschränkungen können einen Download verhindern. Private Inhalte, Anmeldepflicht und DRM werden nicht umgangen.

### Sind die App und die Erweiterung kostenlos?

Ja. Vydrop ist kostenlos und unter der MIT-Lizenz quelloffen. Ein Vydrop-Konto oder Abonnement ist nicht nötig. Die Erweiterung für Chrome, Edge oder Firefox ist optional. Die App enthält keine Telemetrie.

### Verbessert eine höhere MP3-Bitrate die Tonqualität?

Eine höhere Ausgabebitrate stellt verlorene Details der Quelle nicht wieder her. Die angebotenen Werte richten sich nach ermittelten Quelldaten. Auch WAV und FLAC können die ursprüngliche Qualität komprimierter Audiodaten nicht wiederherstellen.

---

Source: https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/download-video-from-any-website-windows.html

# How do I download public web videos on Windows?

Use Vydrop to download public video from any site supported by yt-dlp. It is a Windows app for many websites, with no guarantee that every website or player is supported.

1. Copy the public video's own URL. For a standard HTML5 player, a direct MP4 URL may also work.
2. Paste it into Vydrop and wait for the media details.
3. Choose **Video**, then MP4, MKV or WebM from the format menu. Only compatible inspected streams are offered.
4. Choose an available quality and save folder, then **Download**.

For a video already playing in Chrome, Edge or Firefox, follow the [illustrated companion setup](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html). Its button sits inside the video's top-right corner and opens the format and quality menu. Use the toolbar popup when placement is unavailable.

## If inspection fails

Check that the link is a video rather than a homepage, that it is public without sign-in, and that the site is in the [supported scope](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html). A blob URL is local to the browser and cannot be pasted as a reusable public media link.

![Native Vydrop interface: review format and quality before downloading](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/vydrop-dark-en-download.png)

*Native render of the 4.2.0 source interface, without a mouse pointer.*

---

Source: https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/download-youtube-playlist-windows.html

# How do I download a YouTube playlist on Windows?

Paste a public YouTube playlist link into Vydrop, choose **Whole playlist**, and select the entries to download. Choose video or audio output before starting the selected entries in order.

1. Copy the playlist URL. A video URL containing a list can also offer **This video** and **Whole playlist**.
2. Choose **Choose videos** and retain the entries you want.
3. Choose the format, available quality and save folder. For audio choose **MP3**, M4A, Opus, WAV or FLAC.
4. Start the download and review completed or failed entries in the queue. Open the folder from a completed entry.

## Radio mixes and unavailable entries

A YouTube radio mix changes over time; the app inspects a finite snapshot rather than promising the entire changing mix. Private, removed and sign-in-only entries may be unavailable. A rate-limit or exhausted compatibility error may stop later work so it can be reviewed.

Only compatible completed outputs are eligible for resume. Subtitle settings are part of the output profile. See [audio quality](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/youtube-to-mp3-windows.html) and [caption formats](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/youtube-subtitles-srt.html).

# Download and install Vydrop for Windows

**Vydrop is a free, open-source video and audio downloader for Windows 10/11 x64.** Download the packaged app from the project's GitHub Releases page. The desktop interface supports English and Arabic.

[Download Vydrop 4.4.6 — Complete ZIP](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) · [Windows installer (optional)](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/VydropSetup-v4.4.6-win-x64.exe) · [Release notes](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/tag/v4.4.6)

The ZIP contains **Vydrop.exe**, **Browser/chromium** and **Browser/firefox**. Extract the entire archive; opening only the EXE inside the ZIP does not unpack the companion folders.

Both packages include companion **1.5.4** and the latest Reddit player, Twitch clip-format and Dailymotion link fixes. When updating an existing unpacked companion, reload it in your browser's Extensions page and refresh video tabs.

## Run the extracted app

1. Extract the complete ZIP to a permanent writable folder, such as **Documents\Vydrop**.
2. Open **Vydrop.exe** from the extracted folder. Keep **Browser** beside it if you want browser integration.
3. Paste a public video's own link. Wait for its title and available quality, choose Video or Audio, then choose **Download**.
4. For browser handoff, follow the [illustrated extension guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html).

The companion opens a format and quality menu. Confirm Download to start the chosen output in your saved folder; older app versions open a review screen. Vydrop does not import browser cookies or unlock private or DRM-protected media. See [supported sites and limitations](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html).

## Choose the application package

| Item | What you need |
| --- | --- |
| Operating system | Windows 10 or Windows 11, x64 |
| Installer | `VydropSetup-v4.4.6-win-x64.exe` from GitHub Releases |
| Portable app | `Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip`; extract the complete folder |
| .NET | Included in the package; no separate runtime installation |
| Media tools | Missing tools are prepared when needed; first use needs an internet connection |
| Browser companion | Optional Chrome, Edge or Firefox companion, inside the app's **Browser** folder |
| Account or payment | No Vydrop account, API key or subscription |

GitHub's **Code → Download ZIP** downloads the source code. Choose the named Windows ZIP under **Releases → Assets** for the ready-to-run app. There is no native macOS or Linux package in this release.

## Optional: use the Windows installer

1. Run **VydropSetup-v4.4.6-win-x64.exe**. Installation is for your Windows account and does not need administrator rights.
2. Open **Vydrop** from Start. Setup installs the app, creates its uninstaller and registers the browser connection automatically.
3. To add the optional companion, open **Settings → Browser integration**. Store listings are still pending: choose **choose your browser → Set up**, finish the browser's loading step, then use **Test connection**.

The installer closes the setup gap on the app side. Your browser still requires approval to load an extension. See the [illustrated extension guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html).

## Check the publisher and package

The official repository is **[ZiadHassanein/Vydrop](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop)**, maintained by Ziad Hassanein. Review its release notes and asset details before running a package. The current Windows executable is **not Authenticode-signed**. A checksum or GitHub asset digest can detect a changed download relative to that publisher; it is not independent proof that a package is safe. Read the [security policy](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for the full trust boundary.

## Update an existing copy

Downloading a new ZIP does not change a running older copy. Close Vydrop, extract the complete new ZIP into the existing app folder and replace the app files, including the **Browser** folder. Keep your downloaded media and local app-data files. Compatible settings, queue and history remain in their existing storage location. Reload the companion and refresh video tabs. If you use a new folder instead, open **Settings → Browser integration** and reconnect from that copy so the browser opens the new app. Installed copies can alternatively use the new installer.

In **Settings**, choose **Check for updates**, then **Install**. The verified update replaces the app and both bundled browser companions together, restarts Vydrop, and preserves compatible settings, queue, history and downloaded media. Reload the extension in the browser and refresh video tabs. If an earlier copy still points to another companion folder, use **Browser integration → Set up** to reconnect the matching files.

Versions through **4.2.1** need one manual download after the repository was renamed from ViFree to Vydrop. Open the new **Vydrop.exe** and update any shortcut that still points to an older copy. Application updates and media-tool updates are separate: **Settings → Update downloader** checks the media tools, not the desktop application package.

Settings and recent-file history use `%LocalAppData%\YouTubeDownloader` for compatibility. Your media files remain in your chosen save folder. See [troubleshooting](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/troubleshooting.html) if the app cannot check a video or the companion shows Try again.

# Vydrop: a free video downloader for Windows

[Download Vydrop for Windows](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) · Windows 10/11 x64 · v4.4.6

Vydrop 4.4.6 is a free, open-source video and audio downloader by Ziad Hassanein. This guide uses US English. The desktop app runs on Windows 10 or 11, x64, and its interface supports English and Arabic. The same official download is used worldwide.

## Get the portable Windows app

Download the ZIP from the official GitHub release, extract the entire folder, and open **Vydrop.exe** from the extracted folder. Keep its **Browser** folder if you want the optional extension. The .NET runtime is bundled. On first use, missing media tools are downloaded and verified automatically; allow time for preparation and enough disk space for the tools and your media.

To check Windows compatibility, open **Settings → System → About** and look for an x64-based processor. Vydrop does not provide a native macOS, Linux, Android or iPhone app.

## Save a video for offline viewing

1. Copy the video's own public URL, rather than a social network's homepage.
2. Paste it into Vydrop. The Download button shows the checking state while the app inspects available streams.
3. Choose **Video** or **Audio**, the format and an available quality. Choose the folder where you want to save the file.
4. Click **Download**. Use **Queue** for several links or choose specific entries from a playlist.
5. After completion, open the output folder from the completed action, queue or **Recent downloads**.

## Choose a format that fits your source

| Task | Available choices | What determines the result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keep the video | MP4, MKV or WebM | The inspected video and audio streams must fit the container. |
| Save only audio | MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV or FLAC | The original audio quality and the selected encoding. |
| Save captions | SRT or VTT | Subtitle languages exposed by the source video. |

A larger bitrate does not recover detail missing from the source. WAV and FLAC do not turn compressed audio into a higher-quality original. Vydrop offers measured or inspected choices; an unknown audio source may offer Automatic.

## Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox

In Vydrop, open **Browser integration → choose your browser → Set up**. Then install the included companion 1.5.4:

- **Chrome:** open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, then load the extracted **Browser/chromium** folder.
- **Edge:** open edge://extensions, enable Developer mode, then load **Browser/chromium**.
- **Firefox:** open about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox, choose Load Temporary Add-on and select **Browser/firefox/manifest.json**. This temporary installation must be loaded again after Firefox restarts.

Allow access to the websites you use and refresh existing video tabs. **Download by Vydrop** appears inside the playing video’s top-right corner. Choose Video or Audio, format and quality, then confirm Download to start the output in the saved folder, including when the app is closed. Older app versions open the review workflow.

See the [illustrated browser guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html), [supported sites](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html) and [security details](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Only save media you have permission to download. Private, sign-in-only and DRM-protected media are unsupported.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can Vydrop download videos from sites other than YouTube?

Yes. Vydrop uses yt-dlp for public pages from 1,000+ supported sites, including TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, X/Twitter, Reddit, Dailymotion and Twitch clips. Direct MP4/MP3 links also work. Site changes and access restrictions can prevent a particular download.

### Is there a free open-source Windows downloader with Arabic?

Yes. Vydrop is free under the MIT license, runs on Windows 10/11 x64, and includes English and Arabic interfaces with light and dark themes. The .NET runtime is bundled; missing media tools are prepared automatically.

### Does Vydrop download TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo or X videos?

Yes, when the public video is supported by yt-dlp and available without signing in. Paste the video’s own link, not the homepage. The extension can resolve a playing video, but custom players and site restrictions can limit detection.

### Can I download a video playing in my browser?

Use the optional Chrome, Edge or Firefox companion. Click Download by Vydrop inside the playing video, choose Video or Audio, format and quality, then confirm Download. Vydrop starts that output in your saved folder, even if the app was closed. Older app versions open a review screen. Detection varies by website.

### How do I save a YouTube playlist as MP3 on Windows?

Paste a public playlist link, choose Whole playlist, select the entries, choose Audio → MP3 and an available audio quality, then choose Download. The app processes the selected entries in order. Available quality depends on the original audio.

### Does Vydrop need an account, API key or subscription?

No. Vydrop needs no account, API key or paid subscription. It contacts media sites and official update servers when needed. It does not import browser cookies, bypass sign-in or decrypt DRM. Only download media you have permission to save.

### What happens when a website changes?

Vydrop checks for verified yt-dlp and Deno updates once daily when you use a link and can try one compatible update-and-retry. A site may still require an upstream fix. Use Settings → Update downloader for a manual check; application updates are separate.

# Vydrop: descargar vídeos y audio en Windows

[Descargar Vydrop para Windows](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) · Windows 10/11 x64 · v4.4.6

Vydrop 4.4.6, de Ziad Hassanein, es un programa gratuito y de código abierto para guardar vídeos públicos y audio. Usa yt-dlp para sitios compatibles, como YouTube, TikTok, Facebook o Vimeo. La descarga depende del acceso público al vídeo y de los formatos que facilite la fuente.

## Abrir el programa en Windows

Descarga el ZIP oficial, extrae todos sus archivos a una carpeta con permiso de escritura y abre **Vydrop.exe**. Necesitas Windows 10 u 11 x64. El entorno .NET está incluido; al pegar el primer enlace, el programa prepara y verifica las herramientas multimedia que falten.

Esta guía utiliza español de España. La interfaz de la aplicación está disponible en inglés y árabe: **Video** es vídeo, **Audio** es sonido y **Download** inicia la descarga. El mismo paquete oficial de Windows se utiliza en todos los países.

## Guardar un vídeo, una lista o solo el audio

1. Copia el enlace público del vídeo concreto, no la página principal de la red social.
2. Pégalo en Vydrop y espera a que termine la comprobación indicada en el botón de descarga.
3. Elige **Video** o **Audio**, el formato, una calidad disponible y la carpeta de destino.
4. Pulsa **Download**. Usa **Queue** para varios enlaces o selecciona entradas concretas de una lista de reproducción.
5. Al terminar, abre la carpeta del archivo desde la acción completada, la cola o **Recent downloads**.

## Formatos y calidad de la fuente

| Lo que quieres guardar | Formatos | De qué depende |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Imagen y sonido | MP4, MKV, WebM | Los flujos deben ser compatibles con el contenedor. |
| Solo el audio | MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, FLAC | La calidad original y la codificación elegida. |
| Subtítulos | SRT, VTT | Las pistas e idiomas disponibles en el vídeo. |

Un bitrate mayor no recupera detalles que no existen en la fuente. El programa utiliza los datos medidos o proporcionados por el sitio para ofrecer opciones. Activa **Subtitles** para elegir una pista de subtítulos disponible; la selección aparece en el resumen del vídeo.

## Activar la extensión en el navegador

En Vydrop, abre **Browser integration → choose your browser → Set up**. Después instala la extensión 1.5.4 incluida en la carpeta **Browser** del ZIP extraído:

- **Chrome:** abre chrome://extensions, activa el modo de desarrollador y carga la carpeta **Browser/chromium** sin comprimir.
- **Edge:** abre edge://extensions, activa el modo de desarrollador y carga la misma carpeta.
- **Firefox:** abre about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox y carga **Browser/firefox/manifest.json** como complemento temporal. Debes volver a cargarlo después de reiniciar Firefox.

Permite el acceso a los sitios que utilices y actualiza las pestañas de vídeo. **Download by Vydrop** aparece dentro de la esquina superior derecha del vídeo. Elige vídeo o audio, formato y calidad, y confirma **Download**. La descarga comienza en la carpeta guardada, aunque Vydrop estuviera cerrado. Las versiones anteriores abren la pantalla de revisión.

La [guía ilustrada de la extensión](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html) y los [límites de sitios compatibles](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html) están en inglés. Descarga únicamente medios que tengas permiso para guardar. No se eluden inicios de sesión ni protecciones DRM.

## Preguntas frecuentes

### ¿Vydrop tiene interfaz en español?

Esta guía está en español. La aplicación ofrece actualmente interfaz en inglés y árabe y funciona en Windows 10 y 11 x64. Los pasos de esta página indican los nombres de los botones en inglés.

### ¿Puedo descargar vídeos de cualquier web?

Vydrop utiliza yt-dlp para páginas públicas de más de 1.000 sitios compatibles. Un cambio del sitio, su reproductor o las restricciones de acceso pueden impedir la descarga. No se admiten vídeos privados, contenido que exija iniciar sesión ni medios protegidos por DRM.

### ¿Son gratuitos el programa y la extensión?

Sí. Vydrop es gratuito y de código abierto con licencia MIT. No requiere cuenta de Vydrop ni suscripción y no incluye telemetría. La extensión para Chrome, Edge o Firefox es opcional.

### ¿Un MP3 con más bitrate suena mejor que el original?

No recupera detalles que faltan en el audio de origen. Las opciones dependen de los datos de la fuente. Si se desconocen, puede aparecer Automatic. Guardar en WAV o FLAC tampoco restaura la calidad perdida de una fuente comprimida.

# Vydrop : télécharger des vidéos et de l’audio sur Windows

[Télécharger Vydrop pour Windows](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/releases/download/v4.4.6/Vydrop-v4.4.6-win-x64.zip) · Windows 10/11 x64 · v4.4.6

Vydrop 4.4.6 est un logiciel libre et gratuit de Ziad Hassanein pour enregistrer des vidéos publiques et leur audio sur Windows 10 ou 11 x64. Il prend en charge YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo et d’autres sites compatibles avec yt-dlp. Le téléchargement dépend de l’accès au média et des formats disponibles.

## Installer et lancer Vydrop

Téléchargez l’archive ZIP officielle, décompressez-la dans un dossier accessible en écriture, puis ouvrez **Vydrop.exe**. Le runtime .NET est inclus. Au premier lien, l’application prépare et vérifie les outils multimédias manquants ; une connexion Internet et de l’espace disque sont nécessaires.

L’interface du logiciel est en anglais ou en arabe. Dans les étapes ci-dessous, **Video** signifie vidéo, **Audio** signifie son et **Download** lance le téléchargement. Le présent guide est destiné aux lecteurs francophones, notamment en France ; le fichier Windows officiel est le même pour tous.

## Enregistrer une vidéo ou extraire son audio

1. Copiez le lien public de la vidéo elle-même, et non l’adresse d’accueil du réseau social.
2. Collez-le dans Vydrop et attendez la fin de la vérification indiquée sur le bouton de téléchargement.
3. Sélectionnez **Video** ou **Audio**, le format, une qualité disponible et le dossier de destination.
4. Cliquez sur **Download**. Utilisez **Queue** pour plusieurs liens ou sélectionnez les éléments d’une playlist.
5. Une fois le fichier enregistré, ouvrez son dossier depuis l’action terminée, la file ou **Recent downloads**.

## Formats et qualité réellement disponibles

| Besoin | Formats | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conserver l’image et le son | MP4, MKV, WebM | Les flux doivent être compatibles avec le conteneur. |
| Enregistrer uniquement le son | MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, FLAC | La conversion respecte les limites de la source. |
| Enregistrer des sous-titres | SRT, VTT | La vidéo doit proposer la langue de sous-titres choisie. |

Un débit élevé ne rétablit pas les détails perdus dans le son d’origine. Si le débit de la source est inconnu, le choix automatique évite de promettre une qualité non mesurée. Pour activer les sous-titres, utilisez **Subtitles** ; la sélection apparaît dans le panneau récapitulatif.

## Configurer l’extension du navigateur

Dans Vydrop, ouvrez **Browser integration → choose your browser → Set up**. Installez ensuite l’extension 1.5.4 incluse dans le dossier **Browser** de l’archive décompressée :

- **Chrome :** ouvrez chrome://extensions, activez le mode développeur et chargez le dossier **Browser/chromium**.
- **Edge :** ouvrez edge://extensions et chargez le même dossier après avoir activé le mode développeur.
- **Firefox :** ouvrez about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox et chargez **Browser/firefox/manifest.json** comme module temporaire. Recommencez après un redémarrage de Firefox.

Autorisez l’accès aux sites souhaités et actualisez les onglets vidéo. **Download by Vydrop** apparaît dans l’angle supérieur droit du lecteur. Choisissez vidéo ou audio, le format et la qualité, puis confirmez **Download**. Le téléchargement démarre dans le dossier enregistré, même si Vydrop était fermé. Les anciennes versions ouvrent un écran de vérification.

Le [guide illustré de l’extension](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html) et la [liste des limites de prise en charge](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html) sont en anglais. Enregistrez uniquement les médias que vous avez le droit de télécharger. Vydrop ne contourne pas l’authentification ni les DRM.

## Questions fréquentes

### Vydrop est-il disponible en français ?

Ce guide est en français. L’application propose actuellement une interface en anglais ou en arabe ; ses boutons ne sont pas traduits en français. Elle fonctionne sur Windows 10 et 11 x64.

### Peut-on télécharger une vidéo depuis n’importe quel site ?

Vydrop utilise yt-dlp pour les pages publiques de plus de 1 000 sites pris en charge. La disponibilité du média, le lecteur et les restrictions du site peuvent empêcher un téléchargement. Les contenus privés, nécessitant une connexion ou protégés par DRM ne sont pas pris en charge.

### Le logiciel et l’extension sont-ils gratuits ?

Oui. Vydrop est gratuit et libre sous licence MIT, sans abonnement ni compte Vydrop. L’extension pour Chrome, Edge ou Firefox est facultative. Le logiciel ne collecte pas de télémétrie.

### Un MP3 à débit élevé améliore-t-il la source ?

Non. Un débit de sortie plus élevé ne recrée pas les détails absents du son d’origine. Les choix dépendent des informations mesurées ou fournies par la source. WAV et FLAC ne restaurent pas non plus ces détails.

## At a glance

**Vydrop (formerly ViFree and YouTube Downloader)** is a free, MIT-licensed video and audio downloader for Windows 10/11 x64. Version **4.4.6** uses yt-dlp for public pages from 1,000+ supported sites, including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, X/Twitter, Reddit, Dailymotion and Twitch clips, plus direct MP4/MP3 links. Video outputs: MP4, MKV, WebM. Audio outputs: MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, FLAC. It supports playlists, queues, SRT/VTT subtitles, an optional browser companion, English and Arabic. Private, sign-in-only and DRM-protected media are unsupported. Settings, history and media tools stay locally in `%LocalAppData%\YouTubeDownloader`; downloads use your chosen folder. Vydrop has no telemetry.

Vydrop 4.4.4 Library with completed media, search and a selected-file inspector

Vydrop 4.4.4, captured from the native Windows app at 100% scale with example downloads. No mouse pointer.

**Library** contains completed video and audio files. **Queue** contains waiting, downloading, paused and failed jobs, with its own search, status filters and start/pause controls. Starting a download opens Queue and selects the transfer; completed files appear in Library. **Add download**, Settings and History use the same workspace.

## Why use the desktop app?

| Task | Vydrop | yt-dlp command line | Web converters |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Multiple public sites | yt-dlp support in one window | yt-dlp support | Depends on the service |
| Controls | English/Arabic desktop UI | Command arguments | Browser form; varies |
| Media tools | Missing tools prepared automatically | User manages tools | Service manages tools |
| Playlists, captions, queue | App controls | Command options and scripts | Depends on the service |
| Cost and advertising | Free, no ads | Free, no ads | Pricing and ads vary |
| Browser handoff | Optional companion | Requires another integration | Varies |

Vydrop makes formats, detected quality, progress and completed files available in one local interface. The table describes workflows, not a safety ranking of other products.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can Vydrop download videos from sites other than YouTube?

Yes. Vydrop uses yt-dlp for public pages from 1,000+ supported sites, including TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, X/Twitter, Reddit, Dailymotion and Twitch clips. Direct MP4/MP3 links also work. Site changes and access restrictions can prevent a particular download.

### Is there a free open-source Windows downloader with Arabic?

Yes. Vydrop is free under the MIT license, runs on Windows 10/11 x64, and includes English and Arabic interfaces with light and dark themes. The .NET runtime is bundled; missing media tools are prepared automatically.

### Does Vydrop download TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo or X videos?

Yes, when the public video is supported by yt-dlp and available without signing in. Paste the video’s own link, not the homepage. The extension can resolve a playing video, but custom players and site restrictions can limit detection.

### Can I download a video playing in my browser?

Use the optional Chrome, Edge or Firefox companion. Click Download by Vydrop inside the playing video, choose Video or Audio, format and quality, then confirm Download. Vydrop starts that output in your saved folder, even if the app was closed. Older app versions open a review screen. Detection varies by website.

### How do I save a YouTube playlist as MP3 on Windows?

Paste a public playlist link, choose Whole playlist, select the entries, choose Audio → MP3 and an available audio quality, then choose Download. The app processes the selected entries in order. Available quality depends on the original audio.

### Does Vydrop need an account, API key or subscription?

No. Vydrop needs no account, API key or paid subscription. It contacts media sites and official update servers when needed. It does not import browser cookies, bypass sign-in or decrypt DRM. Only download media you have permission to save.

### What happens when a website changes?

Vydrop checks for verified yt-dlp and Deno updates once daily when you use a link and can try one compatible update-and-retry. A site may still require an upstream fix. Use Settings → Update downloader for a manual check; application updates are separate.

---

Source: https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html

# Which websites does Vydrop support?

Vydrop accepts public HTTP(S) pages supported by yt-dlp, which lists 1,000+ sites. This includes YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, X/Twitter, Reddit, Dailymotion and Twitch clips; compatible direct MP4/MP3 links are also supported.

## Check a particular video

Paste its own public link into Vydrop. Successful inspection shows the title and actual output choices. The [upstream supported-sites list](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md) is the current reference; listing a site does not guarantee every URL works.

## Understand the limits

Private videos, sign-in-only pages and DRM-protected streams are unsupported. An extension button does not establish anonymous download access. Available resolution, audio quality and captions depend on the source. Live streams may need to finish first.

Vydrop checks verified yt-dlp and Deno updates once daily when a link is used, retaining a previous tool selection for recovery. A website change can still require an upstream fix. For a manual check, use **Settings → Update downloader**; this does not update the desktop application.

# How do I send TikTok or Facebook videos to Vydrop?

Vydrop can save supported public TikTok and Facebook videos that do not require sign-in. Send the video's own link, not facebook.com or tiktok.com homepages.

1. Open the specific video or reel and start playback.
2. With the companion enabled, click **Download by Vydrop** beside that player. The extension resolves the selected player's nearby public permalink.
3. Review the resolved link, title and output choices in Vydrop, then choose **Download**.

If detection is ambiguous, use the website's **Share → Copy link** action and paste that link. Never send cookies, passwords or account exports to support. Being signed in to view a video does not mean the downloader can access it anonymously.

See the [Chrome, Edge and Firefox setup guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html) and [supported-site limits](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html). Site changes may require an upstream update; watermark removal is not promised.

![Native Vydrop interface: review format and quality before downloading](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/images/screenshots/vydrop-dark-en-download.png)

# Troubleshoot Vydrop on Windows

Start with the latest [official Windows package](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/download.html) and the exact video's own public link. A working browser page does not always expose a stream Vydrop can download. These steps distinguish the app connection, video detection, media extraction and saved file location.

## The extension says Try again, or the app does not open

1. Open the Vydrop copy you intend to use. Choose **Settings → Browser integration** and enable or reconnect it.
2. Keep that executable in its permanent folder. Moving or deleting it leaves the browser pointing to an old app location.
3. Confirm the companion is enabled and loaded from the matching package's **Browser\chromium** folder, or **Browser\firefox\manifest.json** in Firefox.
4. After reloading an extension, refresh the video page and play the video again. Try its Vydrop button or the extension's toolbar action.
5. Close the setup dialog before sending a video. The app also needs to finish or cancel any active download before accepting another link.

Once the native connection is registered, it is designed to start Vydrop when closed. A browser button appearing is not proof that this connection works. Follow the [browser-specific illustrated setup](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/browser-extension-setup.html), including the real send-to-app test.

## The video button is missing

The overlay follows a visible playing video. Play the video, keep it in view, and refresh after an extension update. Check that the companion has access to that site. An iframe, custom player or multiple visible videos can prevent unambiguous detection. Use the toolbar action on the video's own page, or paste its share link into Vydrop.

## Could not check video

Use the video's own link instead of a profile, feed or website homepage. Check that it is public and reachable without signing in. Check your connection, then use **Settings → Update downloader** and retry once. A recent site change may require an upstream yt-dlp fix; repeated retries cannot remove site restrictions.

For LinkedIn, use the companion on the playing video. Some LinkedIn post URLs cannot be extracted directly even though the browser can play the video. Detection may still fail on private or unsupported players. Vydrop does not import your login session.

## A format or quality is unavailable

Vydrop lists choices from the detected source. A low-resolution source does not become HD by selecting a different container. MP4/MKV/WebM describe the file container. Audio conversion targets such as MP3 bitrate do not restore missing source detail. See the [MP3 guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/youtube-to-mp3-windows.html) and [site limitations](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html).

## No subtitles are listed

Only captions exposed by the source can be saved. For a playlist, choose **Get subtitle languages**; those results come from the first available video and may differ for other entries. **SRT** and **VTT** choose the sidecar file format. Vydrop does not generate new captions by speech recognition. See [subtitle instructions](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/youtube-subtitles-srt.html).

## A completed file cannot be opened

Recent downloads records the saved path. If the file was renamed, moved or deleted outside Vydrop, that old path is unavailable. Check your selected download folder or Windows Recycle Bin. The app cannot recover deleted media; download again only if the source is available and you have permission.

## Report a reproducible problem

[Open a download problem report](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/issues/new?template=download-problem.yml) with the app version, Windows version, public video URL and steps. For browser issues, include the browser and companion versions. Redact personal paths and never post private URLs, cookies, passwords or tokens. Report security vulnerabilities through the [private security channel](https://github.com/ZiadHassanein/Vydrop/security/advisories/new).

# How do I save available YouTube subtitles as SRT?

Use **Subtitles** in Vydrop to save an available caption track as SRT or VTT alongside the downloaded media. The app uses the source's captions; it does not create a transcript for a video without captions.

1. Paste the public video link and wait for inspection.
2. Open **Subtitles**, enable captions, and choose an available language. Automatic captions are identified separately when available.
3. Select **SRT** or **VTT** and confirm. Check the selected caption language and format in the media details panel.
4. Download the media. Keep the subtitle sidecar with it for playback.

An unavailable language cannot be promised. A caption track may disappear between inspection and download; refresh the choices or disable subtitles if that happens. See the [playlist guide](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/download-youtube-playlist-windows.html) for selected entries.

# How do I save YouTube audio as MP3 on Windows?

Paste a supported public YouTube video into Vydrop and choose **Audio → MP3**. The app converts the available source audio locally; no account, API key or subscription is needed.

1. Wait for the video details, then choose **Audio** and MP3.
2. Choose **Automatic** or an offered audio quality. Explicit bitrate choices depend on the estimated source and output codec.
3. Select the save folder and choose **Download**.

## Choose quality honestly

An unknown source offers Automatic. Encoding a compressed source at a higher bitrate cannot recover lost detail. WAV and FLAC are available as lossless output containers but do not turn a lossy source into a lossless recording. M4A and Opus are alternative audio outputs.

For several videos, use [playlist selection](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/download-youtube-playlist-windows.html) or the queue. This workflow also applies to other [supported public sites](https://ziadhassanein.github.io/Vydrop/supported-sites.html).
